lanes.recommendation_note: Both claimed guards hold at every producer of caller-visible samples in the crate; tests pin them. Notes are process-only. The score-plugin consumer still keeps its own 0/MAX rate rule (see cross_lane_notes).

findings.file_line: crates/hsk-studio-components/src/instance_resolution.rs:801-811 (write_footprint doc: the host must move (instance_id, "") on every accepted write into the record, including part-record writers); :899 (write_footprint = [(instance_id, "")]); read keys (instance_id, property/<name>) only for properties the edited fields read (:588)
